\begin{theorem}[Update-form Block Jacobi in Real Arithmetic]
\label{theorem:block_jacobi_real}
Let $\mat{a}\ireal{n\times n}$ be decomposed as
$\mat{a}=\mat{d}+\mat{n}$, where $\mat{d}$ is a nonsingular block-diagonal
matrix and $\mat{n}$ contains the off-diagonal blocks. Let
$\vect{x}$ satisfy $\mat{a}\vect{x}=\vect{b}$, and consider the exact
block-Jacobi iteration
\begin{align}
    \mat{d}\vect{c}^{k+1}
    &=\vect{b}-\mat{a}\vect{x}^k,
    &
    \vect{x}^{k+1}
    &=\vect{x}^k+\vect{c}^{k+1}.
\end{align}
Define the forward error $\vect{e}^k\define\vect{x}^k-\vect{x}$ and the
iteration matrix $\mat{p}\define-\mat{d}^{-1}\mat{n}$. Then
\begin{align}
    \vect{e}^{k+1}=\mat{p}\vect{e}^k,
    \qquad
    \vect{e}^k=\mat{p}^k\vect{e}^0,
\end{align}
and hence
\begin{align}
    \abs{\vect{e}^k}
    &\leq \abs{\mat{p}}^k\abs{\vect{e}^0},
    &
    \norm[\infty]{\vect{e}^k}
    &\leq
    \norm[\infty]{\mat{p}}^k
    \norm[\infty]{\vect{e}^0}.
\end{align}
The iteration converges to $\vect{x}$ for every initial guess if and only
if
\begin{align}
    \rho(\mat{p})
    =\rho(\mat{d}^{-1}\mat{n})<1.
\end{align}
In particular, $\norm[\infty]{\mat{p}}<1$ is a sufficient condition for
convergence and makes the iteration a contraction in the infinity norm.
\end{theorem}

namespace Research.BlockJacobi

abbrev Vector (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ
abbrev RealMatrix (n : ℕ) := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ

/-- Coordinates with the same label form a block. No restriction on block sizes
or positivity of the ambient dimension is imposed. -/
def IsBlockSplitting {n m : ℕ} (block : Fin n → Fin m)
    (A D N : RealMatrix n) : Prop :=
  A = D + N ∧
  (∀ i j, block i ≠ block j → D i j = 0) ∧
  (∀ i j, block i = block j → N i j = 0)

/-- The diagonal blocks of the original input matrix. -/
def diagonalBlocks {n m : ℕ} (block : Fin n → Fin m)
    (A : RealMatrix n) : RealMatrix n :=
  fun i j => if block i = block j then A i j else 0

/-- The off-diagonal blocks of the original input matrix. -/
def offDiagonalBlocks {n m : ℕ} (block : Fin n → Fin m)
    (A : RealMatrix n) : RealMatrix n :=
  A - diagonalBlocks block A

/-- The exact residual at an arbitrary current approximation. -/
def residual {n : ℕ} (A : RealMatrix n) (b u : Vector n) : Vector n :=
  b - A.mulVec u

/-- The correction obtained by solving with the diagonal-block matrix.
Nonsingularity is an explicit assumption of the theorem below. -/
def correction {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b u : Vector n) : Vector n :=
  D⁻¹.mulVec (residual A b u)

/-- The update-form Jacobi map. -/
def update {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b u : Vector n) : Vector n :=
  u + correction A D b u

/-- The actual iteration from the supplied initial guess. -/
def iterate {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b x₀ : Vector n) : ℕ → Vector n
  | 0 => x₀
  | k + 1 => update A D b (iterate A D b x₀ k)

/-- Correction numbered as in the paper; the unused zeroth correction is zero. -/
def correctionSequence {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b x₀ : Vector n) :
    ℕ → Vector n
  | 0 => 0
  | k + 1 => correction A D b (iterate A D b x₀ k)

/-- Forward error with respect to the specified exact solution. -/
def error {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b x₀ x : Vector n) (k : ℕ) : Vector n :=
  iterate A D b x₀ k - x

/-- P = -D⁻¹N. -/
def iterationMatrix {n : ℕ} (D N : RealMatrix n) : RealMatrix n :=
  -(D⁻¹ * N)

/-- Entrywise absolute value, distinct from any matrix norm. -/
def matrixAbs {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : RealMatrix n :=
  fun i j => |M i j|

/-- Entrywise absolute value of a vector. -/
def vectorAbs {n : ℕ} (v : Vector n) : Vector n := fun i => |v i|

/-- Induced infinity matrix norm: the largest absolute row sum.
The outer Pi norm is the usual finite supremum norm, with value zero in
dimension zero. This definition avoids the default entrywise matrix norm. -/
def matrixInfNorm {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : ℝ :=
  ‖fun i => ∑ j, |M i j|‖

/-- Complexification retains the nonreal eigenvalues of a real matrix. -/
def complexify {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
  fun i j => (M i j : ℂ)

/-- The usual spectral radius, as an extended nonnegative real.
The spectrum is computed over ℂ, including for a real input matrix. -/
def rho {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : ENNReal :=
  spectralRadius ℂ (complexify M)

/-- Convergence to the specified exact solution for every initial guess. -/
def ConvergesForEveryInitialGuess {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n)
    (b x : Vector n) : Prop :=
  ∀ x₀ : Vector n, Tendsto (iterate A D b x₀) atTop (𝓝 x)

/-- Full update-form block-Jacobi theorem in exact real arithmetic.

The only hypotheses are the block splitting, nonsingularity of D, and Ax=b.
In particular, neither nonsingularity of A nor a convergence criterion is
assumed. The conclusions include the actual correction/update equations,
uniqueness of any sequence satisfying these equations, exact error identities,
componentwise and infinity-norm bounds, the spectral-radius characterization,
and convergence and contraction under the sufficient infinity-norm condition.
-/
theorem block_jacobi_real
    {n m : ℕ} (block : Fin n → Fin m)
    (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x : Vector n)
    (hblocks : IsBlockSplitting block A D N)
    (hD : IsUnit D.det)
    (hsol : A.mulVec x = b) :
    let P := iterationMatrix D N
    -- The block model is exactly the diagonal/off-diagonal decomposition of A.
    (D = diagonalBlocks block A ∧ N = offDiagonalBlocks block A) ∧
    -- The constructed iteration solves the correction system and performs the update.
    (∀ x₀ : Vector n,
      iterate A D b x₀ 0 = x₀ ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ,
        D.mulVec (correctionSequence A D b x₀ (k + 1)) =
          b - A.mulVec (iterate A D b x₀ k) ∧
        iterate A D b x₀ (k + 1) =
          iterate A D b x₀ k + correctionSequence A D b x₀ (k + 1)) ∧
    -- Thus the result also applies to every exact sequence specified in the source.
    (∀ (x₀ : Vector n) (X C : ℕ → Vector n),
      X 0 = x₀ →
      (∀ k, D.mulVec (C (k + 1)) = b - A.mulVec (X k)) →
      (∀ k, X (k + 1) = X k + C (k + 1)) →
      (∀ k, X k = iterate A D b x₀ k) ∧
      (∀ k, C (k + 1) = correctionSequence A D b x₀ (k + 1))) ∧
    -- Error recursion and its two distinct quantitative bounds.
    (∀ (x₀ : Vector n) (k : ℕ),
      error A D b x₀ x (k + 1) = P.mulVec (error A D b x₀ x k) ∧
      error A D b x₀ x k = (P ^ k).mulVec (error A D b x₀ x 0) ∧
      vectorAbs (error A D b x₀ x k) ≤
        (matrixAbs P ^ k).mulVec (vectorAbs (error A D b x₀ x 0)) ∧
      ‖error A D b x₀ x k‖ ≤
        matrixInfNorm P ^ k * ‖error A D b x₀ x 0‖) ∧
    -- The sign does not affect the usual complex spectral radius.
    rho P = rho (D⁻¹ * N) ∧
    (ConvergesForEveryInitialGuess A D b x ↔ rho P < 1) ∧
    -- Lipschitz estimate for the update map, with the stated contraction factor.
    (∀ u v : Vector n,
      ‖update A D b u - update A D b v‖ ≤ matrixInfNorm P * ‖u - v‖) ∧
    (matrixInfNorm P < 1 →
      ConvergesForEveryInitialGuess A D b x ∧
      ∃ q : NNReal, (q : ℝ) = matrixInfNorm P ∧ q < 1 ∧
        LipschitzWith q (update A D b)) := by
  sorry

end Research.BlockJacobi

variable [SeminormedAddCommGroup α] [SeminormedAddCommGroup β]

/-- Seminormed group instance (using sup norm of sup norm) for matrices over a seminormed group. Not
declared as an instance because there are several natural choices for defining the norm of a
matrix. -/
protected def seminormedAddCommGroup : SeminormedAddCommGroup (Matrix m n α) :=
  Pi.seminormedAddCommGroup

attribute [local instance] Matrix.seminormedAddCommGroup

theorem norm_def (A : Matrix m n α) : ‖A‖ = ‖fun i j => A i j‖ := rfl

/-- The norm of a matrix is the sup of the sup of the nnnorm of the entries -/
lemma norm_eq_sup_sup_nnnorm (A : Matrix m n α) :
    ‖A‖ = Finset.sup Finset.univ fun i ↦ Finset.sup Finset.univ fun j ↦ ‖A i j‖₊ := by
  simp_rw [Matrix.norm_def, Pi.norm_def, Pi.nnnorm_def]

theorem nnnorm_def (A : Matrix m n α) : ‖A‖₊ = ‖fun i j => A i j‖₊ := rfl

theorem norm_le_iff {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) {A : Matrix m n α} : ‖A‖ ≤ r ↔ ∀ i j, ‖A i j‖ ≤ r := by
  simp_rw [norm_def, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hr]

theorem nnnorm_le_iff {r : ℝ≥0} {A : Matrix m n α} : ‖A‖₊ ≤ r ↔ ∀ i j, ‖A i j‖₊ ≤ r := by
  simp_rw [nnnorm_def, pi_nnnorm_le_iff]

theorem norm_lt_iff {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {A : Matrix m n α} : ‖A‖ < r ↔ ∀ i j, ‖A i j‖ < r := by
  simp_rw [norm_def, pi_norm_lt_iff hr]

theorem nnnorm_lt_iff {r : ℝ≥0} (hr : 0 < r) {A : Matrix m n α} :
    ‖A‖₊ < r ↔ ∀ i j, ‖A i j‖₊ < r := by
  simp_rw [nnnorm_def, pi_nnnorm_lt_iff hr]

theorem norm_entry_le_entrywise_sup_norm (A : Matrix m n α) {i : m} {j : n} : ‖A i j‖ ≤ ‖A‖ :=
  (norm_le_pi_norm (A i) j).trans (norm_le_pi_norm A i)

theorem nnnorm_entry_le_entrywise_sup_nnnorm (A : Matrix m n α) {i : m} {j : n} : ‖A i j‖₊ ≤ ‖A‖₊ :=
  (nnnorm_le_pi_nnnorm (A i) j).trans (nnnorm_le_pi_nnnorm A i)

@[simp]
theorem nnnorm_map_eq (A : Matrix m n α) (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ a, ‖f a‖₊ = ‖a‖₊) :
    ‖A.map f‖₊ = ‖A‖₊ := by
  simp only [nnnorm_def, Pi.nnnorm_def, Matrix.map_apply, hf]

@[simp]
theorem norm_map_eq (A : Matrix m n α) (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ a, ‖f a‖ = ‖a‖) : ‖A.map f‖ = ‖A‖ :=
  (congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| nnnorm_map_eq A f fun a => Subtype.ext <| hf a :)

@[simp]
theorem nnnorm_transpose (A : Matrix m n α) : ‖Aᵀ‖₊ = ‖A‖₊ :=
  Finset.sup_comm _ _ _

@[simp]
theorem norm_transpose (A : Matrix m n α) : ‖Aᵀ‖ = ‖A‖ :=
  congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| nnnorm_transpose A

@[simp]
theorem nnnorm_conjTranspose [StarAddMonoid α] [NormedStarGroup α] (A : Matrix m n α) :
    ‖Aᴴ‖₊ = ‖A‖₊ :=
  (nnnorm_map_eq _ _ nnnorm_star).trans A.nnnorm_transpose

@[simp]
theorem norm_conjTranspose [StarAddMonoid α] [NormedStarGroup α] (A : Matrix m n α) : ‖Aᴴ‖ = ‖A‖ :=
  congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| nnnorm_conjTranspose A

instance [StarAddMonoid α] [NormedStarGroup α] : NormedStarGroup (Matrix m m α) :=
  ⟨(le_of_eq <| norm_conjTranspose ·)⟩

@[simp]
theorem nnnorm_replicateCol (v : m → α) : ‖replicateCol ι v‖₊ = ‖v‖₊ := by
  simp [nnnorm_def, Pi.nnnorm_def]

@[simp]
theorem norm_replicateCol (v : m → α) : ‖replicateCol ι v‖ = ‖v‖ :=
  congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| nnnorm_replicateCol v

@[simp]
theorem nnnorm_replicateRow (v : n → α) : ‖replicateRow ι v‖₊ = ‖v‖₊ := by
  simp [nnnorm_def, Pi.nnnorm_def]

@[simp]
theorem norm_replicateRow (v : n → α) : ‖replicateRow ι v‖ = ‖v‖ :=
  congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| nnnorm_replicateRow v

@[simp]
theorem nnnorm_diagonal [DecidableEq n] (v : n → α) : ‖diagonal v‖₊ = ‖v‖₊ := by
  simp_rw [nnnorm_def, Pi.nnnorm_def]
  congr 1 with i : 1
  refine le_antisymm (Finset.sup_le fun j hj => ?_) ?_
  · obtain rfl | hij := eq_or_ne i j
    · rw [diagonal_apply_eq]
    · rw [diagonal_apply_ne _ hij, nnnorm_zero]
      exact zero_le _
  · refine Eq.trans_le ?_ (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ i))
    rw [diagonal_apply_eq]

@[simp]
theorem norm_diagonal [DecidableEq n] (v : n → α) : ‖diagonal v‖ = ‖v‖ :=
  congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| nnnorm_diagonal v

/-- Note this is safe as an instance as it carries no data. -/
instance [Nonempty n] [DecidableEq n] [One α] [NormOneClass α] : NormOneClass (Matrix n n α) :=
  ⟨(norm_diagonal _).trans <| norm_one⟩

    SeminormedAddCommGroup (Matrix m n α) :=
  @Pi.seminormedAddCommGroup m _ _ (fun _ ↦ PiLp.seminormedAddCommGroupToPi 1 (fun _ : n ↦ α))

declared as an instance because there are several natural choices for defining the norm of a
matrix. -/

protected def linftyOpNormedAddCommGroup [NormedAddCommGroup α] :
    NormedAddCommGroup (Matrix m n α) :=

theorem linfty_opNNNorm_mul (A : Matrix l m α) (B : Matrix m n α) : ‖A * B‖₊ ≤ ‖A‖₊ * ‖B‖₊ := by
  simp_rw [linfty_opNNNorm_def, Matrix.mul_apply]
  calc
    (Finset.univ.sup fun i => ∑ k, ‖∑ j, A i j * B j k‖₊) ≤
        Finset.univ.sup fun i => ∑ k, ∑ j, ‖A i j‖₊ * ‖B j k‖₊ :=
      Finset.sup_mono_fun fun i _hi =>
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _hk => nnnorm_sum_le_of_le _ fun j _hj => nnnorm_mul_le _ _
    _ = Finset.univ.sup fun i => ∑ j, ‖A i j‖₊ * ∑ k, ‖B j k‖₊ := by
      simp_rw [@Finset.sum_comm m, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ Finset.univ.sup fun i => ∑ j, ‖A i j‖₊ * Finset.univ.sup fun i => ∑ j, ‖B i j‖₊ := by
      refine Finset.sup_mono_fun fun i _hi => ?_
      gcongr with j hj
      exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ ∑ k : n, ‖B i k‖₊) hj
    _ ≤ (Finset.univ.sup fun i => ∑ j, ‖A i j‖₊) * Finset.univ.sup fun i => ∑ j, ‖B i j‖₊ := by
      simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← NNReal.finset_sup_mul]
      rfl

theorem linfty_opNNNorm_mulVec (A : Matrix l m α) (v : m → α) : ‖A *ᵥ v‖₊ ≤ ‖A‖₊ * ‖v‖₊ := by
  rw [← linfty_opNNNorm_replicateCol (ι := Fin 1) (A *ᵥ v),
    ← linfty_opNNNorm_replicateCol v (ι := Fin 1)]
  exact linfty_opNNNorm_mul A (replicateCol (Fin 1) v)

  linfty_opNNNorm_mulVec _ _

/-- Auxiliary construction; an element of norm 1 such that `a * unitOf a = ‖a‖`. -/
private def unitOf (a : α) : α := by classical exact if a = 0 then 1 else ‖a‖ • a⁻¹

private theorem norm_unitOf (a : α) : ‖unitOf a‖₊ = 1 := by
  rw [unitOf]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp
  · rw [← nnnorm_eq_zero] at h
    rw [nnnorm_smul, nnnorm_inv, nnnorm_norm, mul_inv_cancel₀ h]

private theorem mul_unitOf (a : α) : a * unitOf a = algebraMap _ _ (‖a‖₊ : ℝ) := by
  simp only [unitOf, coe_nnnorm]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  · rw [mul_smul_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ h, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

/-!
For a matrix over a field, the norm defined in this section agrees with the operator norm on
`ContinuousLinearMap`s between function types (which have the infinity norm).
-/
section
variable [NontriviallyNormedField α] [NormedAlgebra ℝ α]

lemma linfty_opNNNorm_eq_opNNNorm (A : Matrix m n α) :
    ‖A‖₊ = ‖ContinuousLinearMap.mk (Matrix.mulVecLin A)‖₊ := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.opNNNorm_eq_of_bounds _ (linfty_opNNNorm_mulVec _) fun N hN => ?_]
  rw [linfty_opNNNorm_def]
  refine Finset.sup_le fun i _ => ?_
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n
  · simp
  classical
  let x : n → α := fun j => unitOf (A i j)
  have hxn : ‖x‖₊ = 1 := by
    simp_rw [x, Pi.nnnorm_def, norm_unitOf, Finset.sup_const Finset.univ_nonempty]
  specialize hN x
  rw [hxn, mul_one, Pi.nnnorm_def, Finset.sup_le_iff] at hN
  replace hN := hN i (Finset.mem_univ _)
  dsimp [mulVec, dotProduct] at hN
  simp_rw [x, mul_unitOf, ← map_sum, nnnorm_algebraMap, ← NNReal.coe_sum, NNReal.nnnorm_eq,
    nnnorm_one, mul_one] at hN
  exact hN

lemma linfty_opNorm_eq_opNorm (A : Matrix m n α) :
    ‖A‖ = ‖ContinuousLinearMap.mk (Matrix.mulVecLin A)‖ :=
  congr_arg NNReal.toReal (linfty_opNNNorm_eq_opNNNorm A)

variable [SeminormedAddCommGroup α] [SeminormedAddCommGroup β]

theorem frobenius_nnnorm_def (A : Matrix m n α) :
    ‖A‖₊ = (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A i j‖₊ ^ (2 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  change ‖toLp 2 fun i => toLp 2 fun j => A i j‖₊ = _
  simp_rw [PiLp.nnnorm_eq_of_L2, NNReal.sq_sqrt, NNReal.sqrt_eq_rpow, NNReal.rpow_two]

theorem frobenius_norm_def (A : Matrix m n α) :
    ‖A‖ = (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A i j‖ ^ (2 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
  (congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) (frobenius_nnnorm_def A)).trans <| by simp [NNReal.coe_sum]

@[simp]
theorem frobenius_nnnorm_map_eq (A : Matrix m n α) (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ a, ‖f a‖₊ = ‖a‖₊) :
    ‖A.map f‖₊ = ‖A‖₊ := by simp_rw [frobenius_nnnorm_def, Matrix.map_apply, hf]

@[simp]
theorem frobenius_norm_map_eq (A : Matrix m n α) (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ a, ‖f a‖ = ‖a‖) :
    ‖A.map f‖ = ‖A‖ :=
  (congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| frobenius_nnnorm_map_eq A f fun a => Subtype.ext <| hf a :)

@[simp]
theorem frobenius_nnnorm_transpose (A : Matrix m n α) : ‖Aᵀ‖₊ = ‖A‖₊ := by
  rw [frobenius_nnnorm_def, frobenius_nnnorm_def, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]

@[simp]
theorem frobenius_norm_transpose (A : Matrix m n α) : ‖Aᵀ‖ = ‖A‖ :=
  congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| frobenius_nnnorm_transpose A

@[simp]
theorem frobenius_nnnorm_conjTranspose [StarAddMonoid α] [NormedStarGroup α] (A : Matrix m n α) :
    ‖Aᴴ‖₊ = ‖A‖₊ :=
  (frobenius_nnnorm_map_eq _ _ nnnorm_star).trans A.frobenius_nnnorm_transpose

@[simp]
theorem frobenius_norm_conjTranspose [StarAddMonoid α] [NormedStarGroup α] (A : Matrix m n α) :
    ‖Aᴴ‖ = ‖A‖ :=
  congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| frobenius_nnnorm_conjTranspose A

instance frobenius_normedStarGroup [StarAddMonoid α] [NormedStarGroup α] :
    NormedStarGroup (Matrix m m α) :=
  ⟨(le_of_eq <| frobenius_norm_conjTranspose ·)⟩

lemma frobenius_norm_replicateRow (v : m → α) : ‖replicateRow ι v‖ = ‖toLp 2 v‖ := by
  rw [frobenius_norm_def, Fintype.sum_unique, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  simp only [replicateRow_apply, Real.rpow_two]

@[simp]

  Subtype.ext <| frobenius_norm_replicateRow v

lemma frobenius_norm_replicateCol (v : n → α) : ‖replicateCol ι v‖ = ‖toLp 2 v‖ := by
  simp [frobenius_norm_def, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]

@[simp]

@[simp]
lemma frobenius_nnnorm_diagonal [DecidableEq n] (v : n → α) : ‖diagonal v‖₊ = ‖toLp 2 v‖₊ := by
  simp_rw [frobenius_nnnorm_def, ← Finset.sum_product', Finset.univ_product_univ,
    PiLp.nnnorm_eq_of_L2]
  let s := (Finset.univ : Finset n).map ⟨fun i : n => (i, i), fun i j h => congr_arg Prod.fst h⟩
  rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) fun i _hi his => ?_]
  · rw [Finset.sum_map, NNReal.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    dsimp
    simp_rw [diagonal_apply_eq, NNReal.rpow_two]
  · suffices i.1 ≠ i.2 by rw [diagonal_apply_ne _ this, nnnorm_zero, NNReal.zero_rpow two_ne_zero]
    intro h
    exact Finset.mem_map.not.mp his ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_univ _, Prod.ext rfl h⟩

@[simp]
lemma frobenius_norm_diagonal [DecidableEq n] (v : n → α) : ‖diagonal v‖ = ‖toLp 2 v‖ :=
  (congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) <| frobenius_nnnorm_diagonal v :).trans rfl

theorem frobenius_nnnorm_one [DecidableEq n] [SeminormedAddCommGroup α] [One α] :
    ‖(1 : Matrix n n α)‖₊ = .sqrt (Fintype.card n) * ‖(1 : α)‖₊ := by

    ‖(diagonal 1 : Matrix n n α)‖₊
    _ = ‖toLp 2 (Function.const _ 1)‖₊ := frobenius_nnnorm_diagonal _
    _ = .sqrt (Fintype.card n) * ‖(1 : α)‖₊ := by
      rw [PiLp.nnnorm_toLp_const (ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top (n := 2))]
      simp [NNReal.sqrt_eq_rpow]

    Pi.nnnorm_def, PiLp.nnnorm_eq_of_L2, star_star, nnnorm_star, NNReal.sqrt_eq_rpow,
    NNReal.rpow_two] using nnnorm_inner_le_nnnorm (𝕜 := α) (toLp 2 (star <| A i ·)) (toLp 2 (B · j))

lemma update_sub {n} (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b : Vector n)
    (hs : A = D + N) (hd : IsUnit D.det) (u v : Vector n) :
    update A D b u - update A D b v = (iterationMatrix D N).mulVec (u-v) := by
  have hi := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul D hd
  simp only [update, correction, residual, iterationMatrix, hs, add_mulVec,
    mulVec_sub, mulVec_add, neg_mulVec, ← mulVec_mulVec, hi, one_mulVec]
  abel

lemma update_fixed {n} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b x : Vector n)
    (hx : A.mulVec x = b) : update A D b x = x := by
  simp [update, correction, residual, hx]

lemma error_step {n} (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x x₀ : Vector n)
    (hs : A = D + N) (hd : IsUnit D.det) (hx : A.mulVec x = b) (k) :
    error A D b x₀ x (k+1) = (iterationMatrix D N).mulVec (error A D b x₀ x k) := by
  simpa [error, iterate, update_fixed A D b x hx] using
    update_sub A D N b hs hd (iterate A D b x₀ k) x

lemma error_pow {n} (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x x₀ : Vector n)
    (hs : A = D + N) (hd : IsUnit D.det) (hx : A.mulVec x = b) (k) :
    error A D b x₀ x k = (iterationMatrix D N "'^ k).mulVec (x₀-x) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [error, iterate]
  | succ k ih => rw [error_step A D N b x x₀ hs hd hx, ih, ← mulVec_mulVec, pow_succ'"']

lemma abs_mulVec {n} (M : RealMatrix n) (v : Vector n) :
    vectorAbs (M.mulVec v) ≤ (matrixAbs M).mulVec (vectorAbs v) := by
  intro i
  simpa [vectorAbs, matrixAbs, mulVec, dotProduct, abs_mul] using
    Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun j => M i j * v j)

lemma abs_mono {n} (M : RealMatrix n) (u v : Vector n) (h : u ≤ v) :
    (matrixAbs M).mulVec u ≤ (matrixAbs M).mulVec v := by
  intro i
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h j) (abs_nonneg _)

lemma error_abs {n} (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x x₀ : Vector n)
    (hs : A = D + N) (hd : IsUnit D.det) (hx : A.mulVec x = b) (k) :
    vectorAbs (error A D b x₀ x k) ≤
      (matrixAbs (iterationMatrix D N) "'^ k).mulVec (vectorAbs (x₀-x)) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [error, iterate]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [error_step A D N b x x₀ hs hd hx, pow_succ'"', mulVec_mulVec]
    exact (abs_mulVec _ _).trans (abs_mono _ _ _ ih)

lemma inf_bound {n} (M : RealMatrix n) (v : Vector n) :
    ‖M.mulVec v‖ ≤ matrixInfNorm M * ‖v‖ := by
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).2
  intro i
  calc
    ‖M.mulVec v i‖ ≤ ∑ j, |M i j| * |v j| := by
      simpa [mulVec, dotProduct, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul] using
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun j => M i j * v j)
    _ ≤ ∑ j, |M i j| * ‖v‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm v j) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = (∑ j, |M i j|) * ‖v‖ := (Finset.sum_mul ..).symm
    _ ≤ matrixInfNorm M * ‖v‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      ((le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa [matrixInfNorm, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        norm_le_pi_norm (fun i => ∑ j, |M i j|) i)) (norm_nonneg _)

lemma error_norm {n} (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x x₀ : Vector n)
    (hs : A = D + N) (hd : IsUnit D.det) (hx : A.mulVec x = b) (k) :
    ‖error A D b x₀ x k‖ ≤ matrixInfNorm (iterationMatrix D N)"'^k * ‖x₀-x‖ := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [error, iterate]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [error_step A D N b x x₀ hs hd hx, pow_succ'"']
    exact (inf_bound _ _).trans (by
      simpa [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (norm_nonneg _))

lemma rho_neg {n} (M : RealMatrix n) : rho (-M) = rho M := by
  have hc : complexify (-M) = -complexify M := by ext i j; simp [complexify]
  unfold rho
  rw [hc, spectralRadius, ← spectrum.neg_eq]
  simp only [Set.mem_neg, iSup_neg, nnnorm_neg]
